subject: BCP readiness pack + request for technical walkthrough (AcuityPayments)
messages:
From: Jen Sullivan <jen.sullivan@acuitypayments.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@acuitypayments.com
Date: Mon, Jun 30, 2025 at 09:12 AM -0400
Subject: BCP/DR readiness checklist — follow-up and artifacts request

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Thanks again for the overview last week. Our security and operations teams are running through the final SIG/SOC2 readiness checks and we need a concise set of artifacts from Redwood so we can close the BCP/DR section of our questionnaire. High level asks below — I've attached the working spreadsheet with the specific SIG questions (Acuity_BCP_Questions_v2.xlsx).

- Confirm per-region RTO and RPO (typical and tested) for the hosted API and dedicated pools; note differences for single-region vs multi-region failover.
- Provide an excerpt (2-3 pages) of the runbook you’d use for a total region outage (failover trigger, role responsibilities, key commands).
- KV cache warm times observed during last two warmup tests and any sample traces (token warm-up traces).
- Snapshot cadence for service-critical state (S3/GCS snapshot frequency, retention, offsite copies).
- Who is the designated on-call lead during a DR activation and the escalation chain (names and phone/email).

We are aiming to complete this section by end of next week (Jul 7). Can you confirm whether you can provide the artifacts and a 45-minute technical walkthrough this week or early next? If possible, include an internal ops witness who can demonstrate the warm-start sequence.

Thanks — simple one-line confirmations are fine.

Best,
Jen Sullivan
Head of Security Operations
Acuity Payments
[Attachment: Acuity_BCP_Questions_v2.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Jen Sullivan <jen.sullivan@acuitypayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, Jun 30, 2025 at 10:03 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: BCP/DR readiness checklist — follow-up and artifacts request

Jen — thanks for the clear asks and the spreadsheet. We're on it. Quick confirmations and next steps: 

- RTO/RPO: We'll provide a short matrix for hosted API and dedicated (in-region: RTO target 15 minutes, RPO < 60s for KV-backed services; cross-region failover: RTO target 45-90 minutes depending on dataset size). These are our tested targets; we'll attach the most recent test run logs.
- Runbook excerpt: attaching a 2-page excerpt that covers failover trigger, primary autonotify steps, and recovery checklist.
- KV cache warm times: we'll include two recent warmup traces (30m and 5m warm paths) and a short note about warm-cache priming.
- Snapshot cadence: daily application-state snapshots with 30-day retention for primary bucket; weekly cross-region replication snapshots retained for 90 days.
- On-call/escalation: Ben Carter is our primary DR tech lead for Acuity; Marissa will be the exec contact for attestation/signoff.

I've attached a short summary PDF to get you started. We can run a 45-minute walkthrough on Wed Jul 2 at 10:00 AM PT or Thu Jul 3 at 11:00 AM PT; please pick whichever works and we'll send a calendar invite. Ops witness: Ben will do the warm-start demo.

Attachments: Redwood_BCP_Summary.pdf, kv-cache-warm-traces-20250625.log

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_BCP_Summary.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: kv-cache-warm-traces-20250625.log (LOG)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jen Sullivan <jen.sullivan@acuitypayments.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, Jul 1, 2025 at 08:21 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: BCP/DR readiness checklist — follow-up and artifacts request

Jen / team — adding a couple of clarifications so your reviewers have precise language for the SIG: 

1) RTO/RPO definitions: we will supply both the target SLOs and the last three test results (timestamps + measured recovery duration). Call out: for low-latency KV-backed endpoints, the RPO is best-effort sub-60s because of streaming replication; for batch ingestion pipelines, RPO is measured in minutes.

2) Runbook excerpt: the attached excerpt is redacted to remove internal runbook step IDs and jump links, but it preserves command sequences and notification templates. If your team requires verbatim operational runbook text, we'll need an NDA addendum (standard procedure for full runbook disclosure).

3) Snapshots and retention: snapshots are incremental every 4 hours for stateful stores, with a full daily snapshot. Cross-region replication asynchronously copies nightly and we keep replication archives for 90 days. For SIG/CAIQ you can cite the incremental cadence and the retention windows.

4) Witness plan: Ben will perform a warm-start demo in a dry-run environment (no live customer keys) and will capture the console trace and timings. We will provide a short recorded clip if your legal team prefers an artifact over live witness.

If you confirm the walkthrough slot (we've tentatively held Wed Jul 2 10:00 AM PT), Ben and I will prepare the demo checklist and provide a short runbook excerpt for your packet.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Reliability Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runbook_excerpt_redacted.pdf (PDF)]

From: Jen Sullivan <jen.sullivan@acuitypayments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@acuitypayments.com, ops@acuitypayments.com
Date: Wed, Jul 2, 2025 at 16:45 PM -04:00
Subject: Re: BCP/DR readiness checklist — follow-up and artifacts request

Marissa / Priyom — this looks great, thank you. Wed Jul 2 10:00 AM PT works for the walkthrough (we'll join remotely). A couple quick remaining items: 

- Please upload the runbook excerpt and the three most recent test logs to the Drive folder you shared and post the link in this thread.
- We also need a short signed attestation (one paragraph) from Redwood confirming the RTO/RPO SLOs you provided are accurate and reflect the latest tests. Our legal team (cc'ed) will accept an emailed attestation.
- If you can include the recorded warm-start clip (or a timeboxed live demo), that will satisfy our witness requirement.

Once we have those items we'll mark the SIG BCP section as ready; appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Jen Sullivan
Head of Security Operations
Acuity Payments
